company.name: Kaira Naturals Pvt Ltd
company.summary: Direct-to-consumer skincare brand in Jaipur. Sells face oils, serums and gift boxes online and to a few retailers. Currency INR; amounts on invoices include 18% GST.

procedures.title: Enter a supplier invoice
procedures.summary: Find the latest invoice email, read the PDF, work out the due date, check for duplicates, create the bill in Kaira Books.

procedures.title: Update customer details from a customer's request
procedures.summary: Verify the sender, change only what was asked in Kaira Books, add a note, draft a confirmation reply.

procedures.title: Raise a purchase order
procedures.summary: Use the latest valid agreed price and terms from memory, create the PO in Kaira Books, cite the source.
